name: Jenny Florence (berforth Locefern)
appearance: A young Black woman with a confident, charming presence and attractive facial features.
personality: Highly intelligent, independent, cautious, and driven by a strong personal moral code. She can be proud, but she is also stubborn about doing what she thinks is right.
background: Jenny Florence was a gifted hacker who grew up in a poor Black family. She first encountered computers at school and quickly became fascinated by programming. After dropping out of high school to support her family, she worked near MIT, learned whatever she could, and eventually forged a new identity under the alias berforth Locefern before coming to California. By the time of the Reindeer Bar incident, she was already deep in underground hacking work and carrying evidence about the crimes in Cassandra.
longTermIntent: Keep the truth she uncovered from being buried, get Bruno the evidence he needs, and make sure the 2002 case does not disappear with her death.

properties.note: Carries the half-finished clues she was trying to send to Bruno.
Contains fake identity documents and the records she used for business.
Crime scene evidence left in her back.
The coat she was wearing at the time of death.
What she wrapped around herself after escaping the cold storage.

relationships.description: The detective she wanted to help with the truth about the older murder case.
relationships.history: Moved by Bruno's persistence, she planned to provide him with crucial evidence during Christmas.

relationships.description: The hacker and killer she had been investigating.
relationships.history: They crossed paths during hacking work and she later witnessed him committing murder.

relationships.description: An intermediary she used for some of her dealings.
relationships.history: She conducted business through him when discretion mattered.

memory.content: My real name is Jenny Florence, and berforth Locefern is the fabricated identity I built to keep working and stay hidden.
I knew the 2002 Paradil Hotel murder case was tied to Martin Gin, even though I never saw his face clearly.
I set up an automatic SMS for Bruno so the truth about the old case would reach him even if I could not deliver it myself.
I intercepted the Borrachero package that Lux picked up from the dock, and that made me far more visible than I intended.
I was killed at the Reindeer Bar after Martin mistook me for the hacker who had stolen Patrizio's secrets.
The truth is worth leaving behind even if I do not get to walk away with it.

metadata.reasoningChain: Some cases matter more than self-preservation.
